Admission
The call for the 42° cycle (PhD start on 1 November 2026) is now open!
Click here to access the call for the 42° cycle
To participate in the PhD programme selections you have to submit your application following the information provided in the Call for applications (see links blow).
Any graduate (or graduate-to-be) student can apply to the PhD programme. However, the candidates must hold a second level degree at the beginning of the PhD programme (November, 1st each year).
The selection of the candidates is a 2-step process:
CV and project proposal evaluation;
Interview (in-person or via skype) with the Admission committee;
The ranking and the list of the selected candidates will be published after the selections; then the candidates are requested to enroll in the PhD programme at the University office.
For further information, please check the links on the 'Highlights' section of this page.
